en.headline: Observatory extends thunderstorm warning to 10:30am
en.dek: The amber rainstorm signal remains in force as Sai Kung and Lantau record more than 70 millimetres.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory extended the thunderstorm warning until 10:30 a.m. on Saturday, in a bulletin dispatched at 8:35 a.m. A few thunderstorms are expected over Hong Kong. The warning was first issued at 3:55 p.m. on Friday and has been carried through the night.

The amber rainstorm warning, issued at 4:00 a.m., remained in force. The Observatory said heavy rain had fallen or was expected generally over Hong Kong, exceeding 30 millimetres in an hour, and was likely to continue. It warned of flooding in some low-lying and poorly drained areas, and advised people to stay away from watercourses because of the risk of flash floods.

At 8 a.m. the Observatory recorded 26 degrees Celsius and relative humidity of 93 per cent. Oriental Daily, citing Observatory figures, reported that many places had already logged more than 30 millimetres by morning, with Sai Kung and Lantau above 70 millimetres. Saturday's forecast is cloudy with showers, heavier rain and thunderstorms in the morning, and a high of about 30 degrees under a moderate easterly.

zh.headline: 天文台把雷暴警告延長至上午10時30分
zh.dek: 黃色暴雨警告仍然生效，西貢及大嶼山今早雨量超過70毫米。
body: 香港天文台周六上午8時35分公布，把雷暴警告延長至上午10時30分，預料本港有幾陣雷暴。這則警告周五下午3時55分首次發出，並一直維持至周六早上。
凌晨4時發出的黃色暴雨警告信號仍然生效。天文台表示，香港廣泛地區已下或預料會下大雨，雨量超過每小時30毫米，並可能持續。署方提醒低窪及排水不良地區可能水浸，市民應遠離河道，以防山洪。
上午8時，天文台總部錄得氣溫26度，相對濕度93%。《東方日報》引述天文台數字報道，今早多處錄得超過30毫米雨量，西貢及大嶼山更超過70毫米。預測周六大致多雲及有驟雨，早上雨勢有時頗大及有幾陣雷暴，日間最高氣溫約30度，吹和緩偏東風。
